summary: Iteration 5 — Share Cards + Continue Listening + Downloads Manager. Backend regression: 30/30 pytest PASS (health/home/categories/albums list+detail/songs/search, admin+empty-password admin login + register + /auth/me + wrong-password 401, playback play-increment + recommendations, playlists CRUD + like toggle + liked list + 401 without token, radio, bible books+gen1 verses+audio, neno-la-leo/active, churches list+detail, billing-status, subscription-plans, POST /api/payment/azampay/initiate activates is_premium=true + 401 without token, admin stats/users/analytics/create-album+song, non-admin 403). Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844) verified: (1) SHARE CARD — Home -> tap home-song-0 -> mini-player -> tap mini-player -> /player -> tap player-share -> ShareCardModal renders with Vibe brand row, album art (Asante Bwana artwork), title 'Asante Bwana', artist 'Tumaini Collective', equalizer bars, tagline 'Sikiliza kwenye Vibe 🎵'. share-image-btn label is 'Shiriki Kiungo' on web (isWeb branch). share-link-btn copies link — captured clipboard payload: 'Sikiliza "Asante Bwana" - Tumaini Collective kwenye Vibe 🎵\nhttps://vibe.app/song/song_0cca60d47a1a' — and toast 'Kiungo kimenakiliwa' appears. share-close dismisses modal. No crash on web (ViewShot + expo-sharing paths bypassed via isWeb check in shareImage(). (2) CONTINUE LISTENING — after ~3s of playback, closed player and read localStorage: 'vibe_last_session' = 3899 bytes JSON with { track.title:'Asante Bwana', queue.length:10, position:10.286s }. Reloaded the web app fresh; mini-player reappeared showing 'Asante Bwana / Tumaini Collective' (paused, restored from snapshot, playerRef=null path in PlayerContext L108-123). Tapped mini-play-toggle -> togglePlay() null-guard branch (L353-357) calls loadAndPlay(currentRef.current) -> playback resumes and seeks to saved 10.28s (setTimeout(seekTo(pos), 300) at L236-240). Opened /player and tapped player-queue -> QueueSheet header shows 'Foleni (10)' — full queue restored. (3) DOWNLOADS MANAGER — Navigated to /downloads. downloads-back testID present. Web empty state renders 'Pakua kwenye programu ya simu' + subtitle 'Nyimbo za nje ya mtandao zinapatikana kwenye programu ya Vibe ya Android/iOS.' (correct — downloads are native-only per isWeb branch at downloads.tsx L44-49). downloads-summary + downloads-clear-all + clear-confirm / clear-confirm-yes NOT rendered on web (correct — behind items.length>0 branch, native-only). downloads-back click works when navigation stack exists (direct-URL open shows harmless dev-only 'GO_BACK not handled' warning — not a bug; from Profile the back button has a stack). Deprecated-package warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (AnimatedEqualizer.tsx:41 — carried over from iter_3 and iter_4). No new bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: Still uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents="none"` (react-native-web logs a warning on every load). Migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}`. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedEqualizer.tsx:41 — non-blocking, carried over from iter_3/iter_4.

action_items: (Cosmetic, carried over from iter_3/4) In /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedEqualizer.tsx replace `<View ... pointerEvents="none">` with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareCardModal.tsx (L33-49): shareImage() correctly branches on isWeb (falls back to link() -> shareItem) so ViewShot.captureRef + expo-sharing native modules never execute on web. try/catch around captureRef also falls back to link() — resilient. Button label swaps via `isWeb ? 'Shiriki Kiungo' : 'Shiriki Picha'` and icon swaps `share-social` vs `image` (both verified on web).

PlayerContext.tsx (L108-123): mount effect restores vibe_last_session snapshot into refs+state paused (no playerRef created), so mini-player shows immediately after reload without auto-playing — correct UX. resumePosRef preserved for togglePlay resume path.

PlayerContext.tsx (L351-366) togglePlay: when playerRef=null and currentRef exists (restored session), it calls loadAndPlay(currentRef.current); combined with L236-240 (setTimeout seekTo(resumePosRef.current) if >2s), resume from saved position works. Verified.

PlayerContext.tsx (L171-182) saveSession: fires on pause (L361) and every 5s during playback (L192-195 lastSaveRef throttle). Persistence to storage key SESSION_KEY='vibe_last_session' confirmed (3899-byte JSON captured on web).

downloads.tsx (L44-49): pure isWeb short-circuit returns the get-the-app empty state; L59-71 (summary + clear-all) and L81-95 (confirm modal with testID clear-confirm/clear-confirm-yes) are gated behind items.length>0 and only reachable on native — confirmed not rendered on web (correct).
downloads.ts (referenced): getDownloadsSize/clearAllDownloads/formatBytes + per-download size storage — cannot exercise on web (native-only file system); code paths appear correct by inspection.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested Share Card + Continue Listening + Downloads Manager flows verified on web

seed_data_creation: None (reused existing seeded songs/albums). Backend tests register a fresh TEST_<uuid>@test.com user each session and activate premium via simulated Azam Pay.

Run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_vibe_backend.py -v`. For UI use 390x844 mobile viewport. Continue Listening key is localStorage 'vibe_last_session' (JSON). ShareCardModal on web uses `isWeb` branch — 'Shiriki Kiungo' label, no ViewShot/Sharing native calls, share-link-btn/share-image-btn both funnel to clipboard link. Downloads native-only: DO NOT fail absent downloads-summary/downloads-clear-all/clear-confirm on web — that's expected. AnimatedEqualizer pointerEvents-as-prop warning is a known cosmetic issue.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. All three new features (Share Cards branded modal + web link fallback with 'Kiungo kimenakiliwa' toast, Continue Listening via vibe_last_session snapshot restored paused on mount with resume-to-saved-position via togglePlay, Downloads Manager screen render + web empty state + native-only summary/clear-all guards) work as specified. Single low-severity cosmetic warning carried over from iter_3/4: AnimatedEqualizer still uses pointerEvents as prop — react-native-web deprecation warning at load, non-functional.
